### Decided by the maintainer (2026-10-29)

- **The seven books without a released TWL: wait for a release.** No
  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is

  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.

  glossary for them now; a known gap in the CHANGELOG. #57 asks the content
  team whether an `en_twl` release with them is coming. Not chosen: pinning
  `en_twl` master (unreleased work) or an older full copy
  (`ru_gl/ru_twl` v6).
- **Size: commit it, and cache CI's downloads.** 26.6 MB of glossaries and
  a 4.1 MB `sources.json` go into git. CI caches `.cache/sources/` keyed on
  the hash of `sources.json`, so it fetches from Door43 only when pins
  change. A stale or partial cache cannot change the data: each file is
  named by its id and pinned SHA-256 and hash-checked on every read
  (`scripts/lib/sources.ts`). Checked locally: a cached file overwritten
  with other bytes was refused and deleted, and the next run fetched it
  again, byte-identical.
